column2: [intro]
I go to the gym, but I can't help but laugh
The weights are too heavy, I always get pampered
I just raise my arms to impress everyone
But I'm just a starlet in the world of blondes
I tried to be serious, to move forward
But without believing in it, it doesn't really progress
So I prefer to take it lightly
Life is way too short to stress
I wanted to be serious in my romantic relationships
But without believing in it, I always end up in troubled waters
So I prefer to flirt, flutter from heart to heart
Love is just a game, might as well laugh rather than be measured
I tried to be serious, to move forward
But without believing in it, it doesn't really progress
So I prefer to take it lightly
Life is way too short to stress
[ solo ]
So, dear friends, don't take yourselves too seriously
Enjoy life, make jokes, be joyful
Because in the end, it's no use trying
If we don't believe in it, we might as well take everything with cheerfulness
[outro]
